job_title: Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Software (Vaga Afirmativa para Mulheres)
summary: Lead a software organization of roughly 20–25 people, managing delivery governance, partners, budgets and engineering modernization.
requirements: Established large-team engineering leadership, vendor/software-factory management, budgeting/Opex/cloud costs, architecture discussions, agile/SDLC/cloud governance, vulnerability coordination and AI strategy awareness. No single programming stack is mandatory.
conditions: Full-time employment. Salary and visa sponsorship not disclosed. Office attendance required. Frequency not disclosed. Affirmative-action opening exclusively for women.
